title: Notion says Fireworks AI incident exposed Notion AI chat transcripts in fewer than 1% of workspaces
summary: Notion's advisory, first published November 9, says inference provider Fireworks AI notified it on November 6 of a security incident impacting fewer than 1% of Notion workspaces; Fireworks confirmed the exposed dataset, Notion AI Insights chat transcripts, on November 8. Notion says most were unattributable, disabled Insights and urges affected customers to rotate credentials pasted into Notion AI. SecurityWeek dates the Fireworks incident October 24.
plain: Notion says an AI vendor, Fireworks AI, had a security incident that exposed some Notion AI chats. Notion says fewer than 1% of workspaces were affected and has turned off the feature involved.
exec: An AI vendor breach exposed some customers' Notion AI chats; prompts held by AI providers carry breach risk.
action: Notion advises affected customers to treat the data as exposed, review it using the emailed instructions, and rotate any passwords, API keys or other credentials pasted into Notion AI; customers not contacted need no action for now, Notion says.

sources.name: Notion: Security incident involving a third-party AI vendor

validation.note: Notion's own advisory (primary), plus BleepingComputer and SecurityWeek, each state the exposure of Notion AI chat transcripts via Fireworks AI. Only SecurityWeek gives an incident date (October 24); BleepingComputer's October 23 date refers to a cloud-provider access that may be a separate incident.
